not_shipped.reason: the corpus manifest, pinned in PREREG.md section 2. Its licence note for each base sample names the authors' working folder, which the export's word filter refuses. The 60 PDFs it lists are not in this tree either: they are rendered from public Peppol BIS 3.0 samples whose publisher's documentation restricts redistributing modified copies. Each PDF's sha256 is in corpus/render-receipt.json, which ships

the engine build the run called (engine 0.0.1), pinned in PREREG.md section 2. A build output is not shipped, and the package's source in this tree has changed since, so a build made now will not have this sha256

the shipped ruleset (P) 0.1.0, pinned in PREREG.md section 2. Not copied into this folder: the same bytes ship in this tree at packages/verify/docs/examples/peppol-en16931.ruleset.json and at packages/verify/test/fixtures/golden-rulesets/peppol-en16931.ruleset.v0.1.0.json; compare its sha256 there

imported by lib/extract.mjs for the path of the poppler tool, and the corpus renderer. The prereg does not pin it. It names a folder in the authors' home directory, which the export's word filter refuses, so it does not ship (nor lib/fmt.mjs, which only it imports)

rerun.detail: Its harness, scorer, extractor, supplement ruleset and render receipt ship in this folder byte for byte, as its prereg pins them. The 60 rendered PDFs and their manifest do not: the PDFs are rendered from public Peppol samples whose publisher restricts redistributing modified copies, and the manifest names the authors' folders. The run also called an engine build that a build of today's source does not reproduce.

run.blind_basis: PREREG.sha256 holds the prereg's sha256 with no time of its own; the time 2026-10-03T09:18:31Z was added to it on 2026-10-05 from the list's file-system time. The prereg says it was written after the corpus was rendered (corpus/render-receipt.json records 09:15:26Z) and before any extraction or engine run on it. The list, the added time and the prereg are the authors' own, and the corpus and its planted defects were made by the authors

misses.description: unreadable optional totals defaulted to 0 under peppol-en16931@0.1.0: in X1-N18 an allowance and a charge of 200 each were unreadable and cancel in BR-CO-13, so that check would have PASSed on two wrong inputs; only the stamp also hiding the total without VAT prevented it

X1-D15 was caught by accident under the supplement: the extractor invented the currency SEK from the 'VAT total in accounting currency' row (an OCR-tolerant label match let 'Currency:' match the bare word), and it FAILed only because SEK differs from EUR
